data.title: Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss Gaza, Iran, Saudi during meeting with Donald Trump | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Netanyahu and Trump are also at odds over other issues, including the recent US-Saudi nuclear deal, the pending sale of F-35 fighter jets to Turkey, and the extent of operations in Gaza and Lebanon.
